'''Vigilantes''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2 if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4, with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawns in groups of 1 to 3 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by [[Heavy Bomber|Heavy Bombers]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Vigilantes are slow ranged backline units with melee capabilities.

*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*Their Ranged Attack is performed by them rapidly shooting Projectiles, which leaves a Lingering Cloud when it lands that inflicts Poison and [[Corrosion]].
**Vigilantes will remain at a distance, standing still while firing, only moving if their target is at a close range.
*Vigilantes can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Vigilantes can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them.
*Like other [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], Vigilantes can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport.
*Vigilantes can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherVigilante.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Vigilantes, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Vigilantes' Tendrils, found on the upper sides of their body, can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]], while also giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Vigilantes have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
